sentences.en: The divisional manager will present the budget report.
sentences.zh: 部门经理将会提交预算报告。

sentences.en: Each divisional team has its own set of goals and objectives.
sentences.zh: 每个部门都有自己的目标和计划。

sentences.en: The company is restructuring, with some divisional departments merging.
sentences.zh: 公司正在重组，一些部门可能会合并。
